name: Windsor
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Windsor for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from the Eaton tree lighting (November 28) through the Tween RPG: A Very Honey Heist Christmas at Windsor Library (December 16), with the Cone Tree Lighting Ceremony and the Clearview Frostival (December 4), Windsor Wonderland and the Timnath Holiday Festival (December 5), Santa Stories and Elfish Eats (December 10) and Town Christmas in Severance (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Windsor

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Windsor, including nearby Severance, Timnath and Eaton
  • 2 free events: Windsor Wonderland and the Cone Tree Lighting Ceremony
  • Meet Santa: Windsor Wonderland (December 5), the Timnath Holiday Festival (December 5), Town Christmas in Severance (December 12) and Breakfast with Santa at The Hearth Restaurant and Pub
  • Tree lightings and festivals: the Eaton Home for the Holidays tree lighting (November 28), the Cone Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 4) and Windsor Wonderland (December 5)
  • Library programs: the Clearview Frostival (December 4), Santa Stories and Elfish Eats (December 10) and the Tween RPG (December 16), which are full or waitlisted so register early
  • Season: November 28 to December 16

Planning a bigger day out? Windsor families also use our guide to Fort Collins Christmas events for kids, which covers Garden of Lights and NoCo Winter Wonderland and more.
